## Purpose
Durable register of parentless open bugs whose rebar-debug investigation reaches the not-a-bug or design-choice escalation bar. Keep unresolved decisions here so the operator can resolve them together without losing root-cause context. Each bug retains its detailed evidence and RCA on its own ticket.

**DISSOLVED 2026-08-22 by operator ruling:** this register bundled 4 unrelated pending design rulings; each now lives on its own ticket. See the dissolution comment for the item → ticket mapping.

## Pending decisions
- `afflicted-hexed-arthropods` — choose code-review invocation/enforcement semantics. Recommended compatible contract: explicit CLI/library/MCP `review-code` always runs by sending `enabled=True`; retain `verify.enable_code_review` only as the default for direct/internal verdict production; keep the Gerrit adapter explicit override because deployed receiver activation is already its enforcement control. Alternative: introduce a true `enforce_code_review` key, wire Gerrit voting to it, and coordinate repository plus deployed receiver configuration atomically so the currently-live LLM-Review gate is not silently disabled. → **extracted to `leading-timeless-meadowlark` (7da9-4139-4c7f-4db2, idea)**
- `peach-chemic-hairstreak` — choose the repository Bedrock default and provenance scope. Recommended: pin `us-east-1`, matching the measured provider overlay, CI defaults, service runbook, and compose defaults, and add truthful source metadata so provider provenance reports `repo-config`; keep `REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION` higher precedence. Alternatives: pin `us-west-2` based on the local `frontier-bedrock` profile, or leave the repo unpinned and treat fresh-shell setup as an operator profile/env responsibility. → **already resolved under `peach-chemic-hairstreak` (adb6-4762-90f6-4e30, closed); no new ticket**
- Enrich-drain architecture (escalated via `unamicable-exuberant-chupacabra`, 9c90-9015-78ea-4d2c, closed) — blocked on the RCA of `quenched-defectible-killdeer` (3d57-602f-0b75-48ee, in flight). → **tracked by existing `draughty-callous-tanager` (6148-5d81-8e80-41e8, open), now linked depends_on 3d57**
- `silt-resistant-gonolek` — package-context contract for location-pinned reconciler modules (`_concurrency.py`). → **extracted to `carefree-submissive-barnacle` (e5ea-12f3-177b-485a, idea)**

## Resolved during sweep
- `dragonish-sylphic-sheep` — preserve Chat Completions with `openai-chat:`; future Responses migration tracked by `upbeat-illadvised-springtail`.
- `novel-unwasteful-stonefly` — user authorized broad typed validation, including enum and non-enum coercion, for this bug.
- `stumpy-cinnabar-basenji` — spawn by default, optional caller-supplied context, importable/pickleable callable contract, fail-open serialization boundaries, and no cloudpickle/loky absent a concrete caller.
- `paper-spiritous-halicore` — dense successful criterion banking satisfies the product contract; incremental-gap timing is an oracle-policy preference. Closed as `not_a_bug` after operator acceptance.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Every unresolved not-a-bug or design-choice escalation from the sweep is listed with the exact decision required.
- [x] Each listed bug is linked with `relates_to` and holds its evidence on the source ticket.
- [ ] Operator decisions move entries from Pending to Resolved with the chosen contract recorded. *(Superseded by the 2026-08-22 operator dissolution ruling: pending entries were extracted to per-item tickets instead of being resolved in place.)*
